decision.summary: No new action: with only 4 hours left, all BTC daily and weekly contracts are far too weak to justify a fresh position.
decision.rationale: There are no open positions and the live board offers no valid edge. The nearest daily reach, 79k on May 2, is only about 21%, while every other nearby daily and weekly strike is even weaker. Binance is neutral intraday, not providing the kind of strong confirmation needed to override low probabilities this late in the session. With only around 4 hours remaining until daily expiry, forcing any new trade here would be poor discipline. NO_ACTION is the only sensible choice.
